name: external-ladder-tiles
stage: descriptive (external benchmark; not a promotion gate)

ab2.note: Catanatron AlphaBeta depth 2, 1.5 s cap: the comparator of every earlier external receipt (smoke: p95 decision 0.2 s, so the cap rarely binds; a 20 s-cap depth-2 variant would be the same player and is not run).

ab3.note: Catanatron AlphaBeta depth 3, Catanatron's own 20 s cap (smoke: about 5 min per game, p95 decision 3-11 s, 0 fallbacks in 4 games).

table: the candidate in one seat, three copies of the variant in the others; each seed played with the candidate in all four seats. Hidden state for Catanatron comes from the existing belief-sampled adapter (v13), no cheating.
analysis: Per variant: candidate win share (fair share .25) with a seed-clustered normal 95% CI; truncations; external fallbacks and budget failures (reported, and games with any fallback also reported excluded).
retirement_rule: Retire a variant as a benchmark if the candidate's win share is >= .50 (twice the fair share) with 95% CI lower bound > .40. Otherwise keep it as a benchmark. Fixed before any game (Jerry 2026-11-07: 'retire when we beat them too easily').
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any game (Jerry: 'let's benchmark our best PV model against jsettlers/catanatron'). Same design, budgets and retirement rule as external-ladder-v1 (served planner_offer_accept: ab2 .488, ab3 .455), with the candidate replaced by planner_pv2_tiles (weights npz sha 27dd7818, local artifact). Descriptive comparison with the served bot's ladder (different seeds; not paired). Fresh seeds 2920000 (ab2), 2921000 (ab3). Runs on ultra.
